posts.title: The Zoo Robbery (1973) - A CFF Film
posts.description: A group of children who travel on a canal barge attempt to stop a gang of criminals from smuggling Yen-Yen, the world's only captive Yeti, out of England. After they hear that Yen-Yen has been stolen from the London Zoo, the children track the thieves to a canal boat and discover that they have Yen-Yen onboard and are planning to make their escape that very afternoon!
